A TUF initiative

The New Frontier Africa

A youth leadership development platform preparing emerging African leaders to understand and shape the systems around them.

What is TNFA?

A platform for Africa's emerging leaders.

The New Frontier Africa (TNFA) is a youth leadership development initiative of The Unlimited Foundation. It brings emerging leaders closer to the people, institutions, and ideas shaping Africa's future.

TNFA connects leadership with practical understanding across governance and public service, business and enterprise, technology and innovation, and the responsibilities of leadership in society.

Flagship event

Youth Leadership Summit ’27

The inaugural summit is planned as a full day of leadership dialogue in Freetown, bringing emerging leaders and experienced voices together across public service, enterprise, technology, and society.

Venue: Freetown International Conference Centre, Bintumani

Who it is for: Students, young professionals, entrepreneurs, creatives, and institutions interested in Africa's future.

Registration: Opening soon.

Who TNFA serves

Different paths, a shared future.

Students and young professionals

A place to explore how leadership, institutions, industries, and public life work, while connecting with people and ideas beyond the classroom or workplace.

Entrepreneurs and creatives

A forum for engaging with enterprise, innovation, technology, and the practical work of building ideas that can serve communities.

Institutions and partners

A route for organisations that want to support access, dialogue, professional development, and opportunities for emerging leaders.
